title: Newcastle Push for Benfica’s Amar Dedic, Pocognoli Leads Scotland Race
flags: According to BBC Sport, Newcastle are progressing with a move for Benfica defender Amar Dedic.
BBC Sport also reports that former Monaco head coach Sebastien Pocognoli is the Scottish FA’s frontrunner to replace Steve Clarke.
talkSPORT backs that up, saying Pocognoli has become the new frontrunner for the Scotland job.
